faq: What details do you need for each item?
Photos, condition, brand, model or part numbers, size, weight and your price. If something is missing, we ask rather than guess, because wrong item specifics lead to returns and unhappy buyers.
Can you list items for any category?

Most categories, yes. Some, like branded goods or regulated items, need extra checks from eBay, and we follow those rules. We do not list anything eBay prohibits, or items we cannot confirm are genuine.
Do you use eBay's catalog and product matching?
Yes. Where eBay has a catalog product, we match it so details fill in correctly, and we then add the information that is specific to your item, such as condition and photos.
Will you write about my item's history?
We use only what you tell us. We do not invent provenance, authenticity or condition, so tell us any marks, missing parts or repairs and we describe them plainly.

desc:
Good eBay listing creation turns a pile of items and photos into complete listings that buyers can find and trust. Ecom Swift LLC writes titles, fills in item specifics, describes condition honestly and sets price, quantity and policies in your own eBay account.

## What is eBay listing creation?

eBay listing creation is the work of building a complete listing for an item: a title, a category, item specifics, photos in a sensible order, a description, a price and the shipping and return terms. A listing is complete when a buyer can decide without sending a question, and when eBay search can match it to what the buyer typed.

We create listings from the details and photos you send. We do not copy other sellers' text or images, and we describe only what your item really is.

## Why the listing itself decides whether an item sells

On eBay a buyer usually meets your item as one line in a long list of search results. The title and the first photo get a glance, and everything else waits behind a tap. A vague title or a missing category means the item may never appear for the people who want it.

Missing item specifics cause a quieter loss. Buyers narrow results with filters such as brand, size, color or model. If those fields are empty, your listing drops out when a filter is applied, even if the title is perfect. Complete data is part of being found.

## How good listings affect sales

A listing that matches search terms earns more views, and a listing that answers questions earns more purchases from those views. Condition notes matter here: an honest description of marks, wear or missing parts prevents disputes and returns after the sale, which protects your seller record.

Price, shipping cost and demand still shape the result, and we cannot control them. What we control is the quality of the listing, so the item gets a fair chance at the traffic it deserves.

## What a complete eBay listing includes

- A title that uses the full 80 characters with the words buyers actually search.
- The correct category, chosen after checking where similar items sit.
- Item specifics filled in, including brand, model, size, color and material where they apply.
- A condition description that is plain, specific and truthful.
- Photos arranged so the best image leads and the flaws are shown.
- Variations set up with clean options when an item comes in several sizes or colors.
- Price, quantity and format chosen to suit the item.
- Your business policies for payment, shipping and returns applied.
- Best Offer or quantity settings where they make sense.

## What we do

You send each item's details and photos. We check the category by looking at how comparable listings are filed, write the title, complete the item specifics and prepare the description and condition notes. We then apply your business policies and set the price and quantity you agreed.

Listings are saved as drafts for you to read and approve, or published when you tell us to. The Basic package covers a small batch. The Standard package adds larger batches, variations and photo order. The Premium package adds a shared description layout, a keyword and category sheet you can reuse, and Best Offer and quantity settings.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Photograph every flaw, label and accessory that comes with the item.
- Send model numbers, measurements and material details when you have them.
- State what is included and what is not.
- Check each draft before you publish it.
- Keep a record of your cost so you can price with confidence.

**Avoid:**
- Writing a title in capital letters or filling it with unrelated brand names.
- Calling a used item new or leaving out known faults.
- Using photos taken from other listings or from a supplier site.
- Choosing a category only because it is crowded.
- Leaving item specifics blank because the field looks optional.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller with a stock of items and no time to list them one by one. It suits a business adding a new product range to eBay, and a household clearing a collection who wants listings that look consistent rather than rushed.

## What we need from you

Send photos for each item, the details you know, your preferred price or a range, and any shipping limits. Tell us which items are fragile or need special handling. We never ask for your password. We work as a user with the access eBay allows for your account, and you can end that access at any time.
